meta.title: Someone at the Gate
meta.textType: story: the gist of an illustrated story

paragraphs: Lily wanted a scarf for Grandma, but a small visitor wanted the wool too. On Saturday, Lily invited Mia to knit with her. Mia lived next door, and she liked animals. Mia was coming at ten o'clock. Mom gave Lily her tablet. It had an app with videos about knitting. Lily had a big ball of red wool. She put it on the garden table. Then she sat down and waited for Mia.

At half past nine, Mia was not there yet. Suddenly Pip ran to the gate and said, "Woof, woof!" "Someone is at the gate," said Mom. "Guess who it is." "Is it Mia?" asked Lily. "No, it is too early," said Mom. "Look down." A small white kitten came through the gate. It was Snow, Mia's kitten.

Snow jumped on the table and took the red wool. The ball went across the garden. Pip ran after it, and Snow ran after Pip. They ran in a circle on the grass. The wool went around the chair and the table. Then it went around Pip's legs. Red wool was everywhere. Pip could not move. Lily laughed so much that she could not stand.

Mia came through the gate at ten o'clock. "Snow, you are here!" she said. "I am sorry, Lily." The girls took the wool off Pip and made it into a ball again. Then they opened the app and began to knit. Snow watched them and slept on the grass. A week later, Lily gave Grandma a red scarf. Snow got a small ball of wool too.
